messages:
maria: heads up — we're seeing a big p99 spike on streaming for rdx-tiny-qa in us-west-2 starting ~1770102000. client reports stalls during tool calls.
aj: I can repro in staging. throughput drops and tail latency jumps when requests have repeated tool calls (tool loop).
ingrid: hypothesis: tool loop increases prompt length and triggers fallback to the slower kernel path + KV cache churn. any profs?
profiling-bot: quick summary: CPU spin and memcpy dominant on slow requests. top stacks: runtime::dispatch_slow_kernel -> kv_cache::evict -> io::read_shard. p95_lag increased 3x.
aj: uploading pprof snapshot snippet:
```
# flame (aggregated)
dispatch_slow_kernel 48.3%
kv_cache_evict       21.4%
io_read_shard        12.1%
other                18.2%
```
aj: kernel-selection logs show repeated kernel switches mid-request when sequence length grows > 2048:
```
[info] select_kernel(model=rdx-tiny-qa, seq=1200) -> fast_kernel_avx
[info] select_kernel(model=rdx-tiny-qa, seq=3100) -> fallback_kernel_generic  <-- switch
```
maria: that explains the memcpy/slow-path. also seeing KV cache TTL thrash: many small prefixes invalidating the cache.
sre-oncall: mitigation ideas: 1) temporarily pin kernel to fast_kernel_avx for rdx-tiny-qa, 2) clamp max_batch_size for streaming route, 3) rate-limit detected tool loops at proxy. which is fastest?
ingrid: pinning kernel helps latency but risks correctness for very long seqs. clamp batch_size is safe and immediate. do that first.
aj: I'll push a config change to reduce max_concurrent_batch to 8 for the streaming route.
deploy-bot: started config rollout to us-west-2 streaming pool (canary: 2 hosts) — 1/3 -> OK, 2/3 -> OK, 3/3 -> OK.
profiling-bot: after canary, p99 dropped ~38%, p95 dropped ~22% on affected cluster. KV eviction rate down 45%.
maria: nice. we still need a long-term fix: avoid mid-request kernel switch and improve KV admission for tool-heavy requests.
ingrid: proposal: change kernel selection to be conservative per-request based on predicted max_seq (lookahead from prompt + tool signatures). also add prefix-coalescing in KV to reduce eviction.
aj: I'll file a RFC and a perf test plan. short-term: can we add a proxy heuristic to detect tool-loops (repeated tool calls > N within T) and short-circuit streaming batching?
sre-oncall: yes we can add a simple counter in the gateway — do it as 2-week quick patch.
maria: action items: (1) aj — open RFC + perf harness for kernel-selection (due EOD+3), (2) ingrid — KV prefix coalescing prototype (POC in 1 week), (3) sre-oncall — gateway loop detector + rate limit (2 weeks), (4) aj — follow-up test and monitor.
aj: noted. will post links to RFC and perf runs here when ready.
maria: thanks all, continuing to watch. :eyes:
